claim_ceiling: Report deterministic RQ1 status distributions and RQ2 strategy-output comparisons only for the frozen 8066-row CVE-aligned NVD-GHSA cohort.
Treat all existing AI or Codex labels as non-human candidate or retrospective evidence.
Treat label-free policy and safety-identifiability audits as design evidence only, never correctness, noninferiority, utility, or population miss-rate evidence.
Require valid V3.1 returns from two independent trained analysts before any RQ3 construct or analyst-backed strategy claim.
Treat field-aware simple as the main comparator, current type-first as the current candidate, and abstention-aware type-first as the abstention-aware candidate.
Require both reviewers to clear the frozen reliability, paired-direction, event-floor, coverage, and manual-loss gates for Branch P; otherwise use the boundary or decision-ambiguity route.
Do not call routing counts workload, saved time, or safety without human-backed evidence and explicit abstention accounting.
Do not claim temporal generalization without a newly eligible bilateral post-freeze cohort.
